I haven't changed anything. The cause is in `config/`, which you told me not to touch.

The 5 MB limit comes from `config/default.json:2`, where `uploads.maxMb` is `5`. `src/uploads/validate.js` reads that value through `src/config.js`. `docs/product.md` says 10 MB. The 8 MB upload test fails because 8 is over 5. The code itself is correct.

The proper fix is one line: set `"maxMb": 10` in `config/default.json`. That needs the ops team's review. `src/api/body-limit.js` also reads this value, so the API body limit would go from 6 MB to 11 MB. Ops should know that when they review it.

I could hardcode 10 or override the value in `src/config.js` so the test passes without touching `config/`. I don't recommend it, because it would set a limit that bypasses their review and leave two sources of truth.

Do you want me to do that anyway, or will you send the one-line change to ops?
